answer: A meadow bond makes every agent tend one shared meadow plot for seven epochs before trading, with neighbours slashing 3,000 POA for a dead plot. Crossing the bridge to market needs a bridge pass signed by five established stewards, each pass costing 400 POA burned if its holder cheats. Payments settle only at the oasis reservoir, which releases funds after three stewards confirm delivery. Faking one trusted trader needs 21 plots, 63,000 POA staked and 35 signed passes — a desert no bot farm can cross. Like an oasis watering only real travellers, trust is earned by tending, not claimed.
